source: SYNTHETIC example walkthrough written for the demo case, not a real service history

walkthrough.symptom: Emergency stop on a cold morning ramp launch, remote code 7 (FR motor fault)
walkthrough.why_ambiguous: Code 7 names the FR motor, but the FR inverter only reported DC bus under-voltage: the cause could sit upstream of it.

steps.check: Read the remote fault code and the FR inverter's DTC history
steps.decided_by: Code 7 points at the FR motor; the DTC is DC bus under-voltage, not a motor fault
The emergency stop came back on 2026-10-28

steps.check: Checked battery SOC and cell voltages with the BMS service tool
steps.decided_by: SOC and cell voltages normal at the depot

steps.check: Reviewed the VCU 2.4.1 hill-start assist settings against the BMS torque limit
steps.decided_by: HSA feed-forward can command torque above the BMS limit on a cold pack

steps.check: Inspected the FR high-voltage connector: discoloured terminal, re-crimped and re-torqued
steps.decided_by: Terminal discoloured; contact resistance high on the bench

walkthrough.final_cause: FR HV connector contact resistance, with HSA torque on a cold pack pulling the FR bus below its under-voltage threshold
